_comment: SmartRouter host policy for the MoonAliza build process (the Claude Code session that plans and delegates units). Inputs the lead collects before every dispatch decision, per skills/smart-router/SKILL.md 'Decision flow' step 1. Qualification is host-declared from this session's run history and from graded calibration runs (trace/calibration-<n>/), under the lead's qualification rules (README 'Qualification rules'), and is not an independent review; every evidence ref is a workflow run id in the session's workflow journal plus the unit's ledger row in RUN.md, or a calibration grade entry 'calibration-<n>: <category> PASS|FAIL (n=<k>)'.

harness.note: Workflow tool sub-agents (agent() in a workflow script) and Agent-tool sub-agents; model and effort are per-dispatch options; worktree isolation available

authorization.granted: 2026-10-17 'yes absolutely full permission' to let SmartRouter decide model and effort for MoonAliza build sub-agents
project-stop-rules: red suite: full-suite comparison drifts from the 74-failure baseline
research gate failing on the project

isolation.branch-convention: build/<unit-slug> (host convention; SmartRouter suggests sr/<task-id>/<slug>, recorded as branch-hint)
shared-surfaces: node_modules symlink to the main checkout

accounting.reason: the session runs on a subscription with weekly token limits; no per-call USD accounting exists, so cash caps are advisory, never strict (gates.md Gate 4: a strict cap needs reliable accounting)
accounting.token-estimate-basis: median total tokens per role from this session's 327 recorded sub-agent runs (scratchpad/sr-evidence.txt)
accounting.cost-bound-rule: tokens x output_rate_per_mtok / 1e6 (conservative: output rate >= input rate)

prices.source: SmartRouter tools/prices-2.json @ fbe7bca, verified by its owner against platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing on 2026-10-14

build-core.description: a unit touching auth, credentials, concurrency, persistence or IPC

verification: the new tests green, guard-removal proofs

fix.description: a fix round on review findings

docs-mechanical.description: mechanical documentation or report extraction against a checklist

pin-tests.description: a bounded red-first pin: new tests only, no source change (the calibration-1 pin task); not build-tests, whose units are 250000-token engine journeys
